extractions.expression: (()=>{const f=(name,...args)=>idleon.callFunction(name,...args);const a=name=>idleon.getAttr(name);const c=a('CookMaster');const L=Number(c[1][0]);const e=f('Summoning','EventShopOwned',54,0);const companion=f('Companions',87);const pointPool=(levels,jelly,research)=>{let spent=0;for(const v of levels)spent=Math.round(spent+Number(v));const total=Math.round(L+(1+5*e+(5*companion+jelly)))+research;return{total,spent,available:Math.max(0,total-spent)};};const requirements=Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>f('Summoning2','RankREQcook',i,0));return{level:L,nativeRank:L+1,unlockTier:requirements.reduce((tier,r,i)=>L>=r?i:tier,-1),unlocked:f('Summoning2','isMasteryUnlocked',0,0)===1,experience:Number(c[1][1]),totalLadles:Number(c[1][3]),experienceRequired:f('Summoning2','ExpReqCook',0,0),purplePoints:pointPool(c[2],f('JellyOperation','RoG_BonusQTY',13,0),0),yellowPoints:pointPool(c[0],f('JellyOperation','RoG_BonusQTY',5,0),f('ResearchStuff','Grid_Bonus',190,1)),context:{totalLadles:Number(c[1][3]),totalCookingLevels:a('GetPlayersUsernames').reduce((s,n)=>s+Number(a('PlayerDATABASE').h[n].h.Lv0[10]),0),divorceCakeLevel:Number(a('Meals')[0][73]),totalRibbonRanks:a('Ribbon').slice(28).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r),0),nativeRank:L+1},upgrades:Array.from({length:6},(_,index)=>({index,level:Number(c[2][index]),unlocked:L>=requirements[index],coefficient:f('Summoning2','BonusAmountcook',index,0),effect:f('Summoning2','BonusAmountcook',index,99)}))};})()
